# BaseScript

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("BaseScript")`
- **Abstract**: it cannot be created; other classes inherit from it

The abstract base class of instances that hold Luau code. The code is stored in the `Source` property, so a script is created, copied and saved like any other instance.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Source` | `string` | `""` | read-only to scripts; the editor writes it | The Luau code this script runs. It is stored on the instance, so the script is saved with the scene or stamp that contains it. A running script can read `Source` but cannot write it; only the editor can. To create a script at run time, `Clone` an existing one or use `Instance.stamp`. |
